0022600146.text: The Portland Trail Blazers, 3-0 and on a three-game winning streak, host the 4-0 Memphis Grizzlies, who are on a four-game streak, in Portland's fourth game of the season. Portland is without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), Robert Williams III (knee) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Portland won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 122-114 win in Memphis on March 4, 2026.
